scope: Production client and SSR API bundles, real authenticated POST + filtered SSE through a test-only latency shaper. Two browser contexts; only the primary renders WebGL. Baseline reproduces completion+50ms polling and no prediction in the same fixture. Timing is input queue to an actual scene render with a startup, not physical controller-to-photon latency. Dropped receipts and skipped view events simulate application faults, not Internet packet delivery.

interruptedBatteryRun.reason: Battery at 19%, low-power mode active; observed RAF plateau at 30 Hz. Interrupted and repeated on AC without changing rendering quality.

limits: Five light-attack trials and ten nominal measured seconds per fighter after three seconds of warmup; this is a roster sweep, not the earlier 45-second reference campaign.

Each fighter faces Chrollo; Chrollo faces Hisoka. Two authenticated browser contexts, only the primary renders WebGL. The 1,600 pair matrix is deterministic simulation/replay coverage, not 1,600 GPU profiles.
Queue-to-scene-render timing, not physical input-to-photon or server hit-confirm delay.
Proxy RTT 100 ms with jitter and application-level missed receipts/views; Internet delivery and real remote devices are unmeasured.
Active Parallel Future and Cat’s Name use confirmed presentation; Hanzo changes vessel only after confirmation. This is not complete two-player rollback.
ANGLE Metal GPU query sums are diagnostic and are not displayed frame intervals.
